name: io.github.171county/flyonwallwrench
title: FOTW² — Fly On The Wall
description: Community-intelligence MCP for game developers, modders, and community managers: ask what players are saying across Discord, Reddit, Steam, forums and GitHub, get evidence-ranked answers, and queue approval-gated drafts. No secrets stored; nothing posts without explicit approval.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional Discord bot token for live read adapters; without it the Discord source runs on mock evidence.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional GitHub token for the GitHub Issues/Discussions read adapter.

environmentVariables.name: REDDIT_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional Reddit app client id for the Reddit read adapter (with REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET).
